display.title: Pirkei Avos, Chapter 2: The Eye That Sees and the Ear That Hears
display.summary_short: A Sefirah lesson from Pirkei Avos: remember the eye that sees, the ear that hears, and the book where all our deeds are written, and you will stay humble and do what is right.
display.summary_long: A Sefirah talk from the Tzivos Hashem radio show. Uncle Yossi explains that the days between Pesach and Shavuos are a time to improve our character so we are ready to receive the Torah, which is why we learn a chapter of Pirkei Avos each week. He reviews last week's lesson: Moshe Rabbeinu, the greatest of all people, stayed humble, a lesson he learned from Har Sinai, the lowest mountain. This week's chapter 2 teaches how to become humble by remembering three things: an eye that sees, because Hashem watches everything we do; an ear that hears, so we speak only nice words, never bad language or lies; and that everything we think, say and do is written in a book that is always open before Hashem. Remembering these three things will help us always do what is good in Hashem's eyes.
display.lesson: Hashem sees, hears and records everything; remembering this keeps us humble and careful to do what is right.
